United States Department of the Interior
NATIONAL PARK SERVICE WASHINGTON, D.C. 20240
MAY - 2 1972
Memorandum
To:
Director, Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife
Attention: Chief, Office of Environmental Quality
Through: Assistant Secretary for Fish and Wildlife and Parks of
From:
Actingssistant Director, Cooperative Activities
Subject: Review of draft environmental statement on the proposed
Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972
In accordance with the request of the Acting Chief, Office of Environmental Quality, contained in his letter of March 22, we reviewed the subject draft environmental statement. Our review disclosed that we have no substantive adverse comments to offer.
We appreciate having an opportunity to review the draft environmental statement.
